tracks.label: купувам
tracks.responseMessage: Кажете ми за дома, за който си струва да се преместя. Ще попитам само за подробностите, от които човек се нуждае рецензент, след което ще върна един смятан за подходящ.
tracks.composerPlaceholder: Кажете на Nest какво ви трябва от дома...

processSteps.alt: бъдещ купувач, споделящ частен дом с Nest
processSteps.title: Проведете истински разговор с Nest.
processSteps.body: Говорете за това, от което всъщност се нуждаете: бюджет, задължителни неща, нарушители на сделки и време. Малките детайли принадлежат и на разговора.

processSteps.alt: гнездо и човек рецензент внимателно обмисля един купувач и един дом
processSteps.title: получавате едно прилягане на имота в даден момент.
processSteps.body: Човек преглежда всяко предложение, преди някоя от страните да го види. Няма публичен каталог, класиране или безкрайна филтърна мрежа.

processSteps.alt: Nest представя бъдещ купувач и собственик на жилище след взаимно съгласие
processSteps.title: Отключете заедно въведението.
processSteps.body: След като и двете страни приемат, пълният адрес, данните за контакт и предложеното време за гледане се споделят частно.

roiCalculator.heading: ROI Calculator
roiCalculator.subheading: Model a licensed second-home agent or brokerage using Nest for qualified, human-reviewed introductions in one local market.
roiCalculator.disclaimer: A modeled operating scenario with zero validated paid demand. Nest qualifies and coordinates consented introductions; it does not represent parties, value property, negotiate, earn commissions or guarantee a transaction.

currencyCopy.loading: Checking the local currency. Amounts remain in {currency} until a rate is available.
currencyCopy.unavailable: A current local exchange rate is unavailable. Amounts remain in {currency}.
currencyCopy.converted: Amounts converted from {base} to {currency} using the reference rate dated {date}.
currencyCopy.basis: Currency conversion is not local cost research. Enter your own local costs and contribution assumptions. Language changes do not change amounts.

costCopy.breakdown: How the all-in AI cost is built
costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic savings. Only the portions you assign to actual spending reductions or additional contribution receive a monetary value.

copy.workloadIntro: Model second-home leads, qualification and human review—not property sales, commissions or guaranteed matches.
copy.costIntro: Token, model, tool, infrastructure, platform and reviewer costs are delivery assumptions. Nest price is a separate unvalidated hypothesis.
copy.valueIntro: Capacity is not revenue. Enter observed contribution only after a real agent or brokerage uses and pays for the service.
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from volume × tokens per output. Extra media, tools and infrastructure stay at zero unless they apply. Additional paid review is calculated from review hours and its rate.
copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Operating burden removed (negative productivity) returns capacity. Higher-value work (potential positive productivity) creates economic value only if that capacity is used. Hours alone are not cash savings. Token cost uses a modeled input/output mix, not a provider quote.
copy.formulaLabel: Qualified briefs = leads × qualification rate. Delivery cost includes modeled token, model, tool, infrastructure, platform and human-review cost. Customer ROI remains unavailable until benefit and price are supported by evidence.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: These benefits are distinct; I have excluded costs and losses already counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my outcomes; unselected outcomes have no financial value in this estimate.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: Complete the selected assumptions to calculate financial value.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Review takes more time than the work reduced. No positive capacity is available at these assumptions.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the benefits do not overlap before including them in the financial result.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.

volume.label: Leads or briefs entering the desk each month
volume.help: Count inbound second-home enquiries in the selected market, not property transactions.

accepted_rate.label: Share becoming qualified briefs
accepted_rate.help: A modeled qualification rate. Replace it with observed funnel data after a pilot.

attendance_rate.label: Expected attendance rate
attendance_rate.help: Modeled share of accepted meetings expected to happen. Replace this with verified event records after a pilot.

minutes.label: Minutes to qualify one buyer brief today
minutes.help: Active intake and qualification time, excluding elapsed days and property-search time.

automation.label: Share of that work reduced
automation.help: An illustrative assumption to validate in a pilot, not a performance promise.

review.label: Minutes a reviewer spends confirming each brief
review.help: Human review still required before either side sees a proposal.

cycles_per_unit.label: Cycles per unit each month
cycles_per_unit.help: How many recurring order, review or processing cycles each unit runs in a typical month.

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens per qualified buyer brief
tokens_per_output.help: Modeled input and output tokens for one reviewable brief; provider usage must replace this hypothesis.

budget.label: Estimated monthly operating budget
budget.help: Include token usage, models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review.

model_cost.label: Additional model or media cost
model_cost.help: Enter separately billed models or media. Leave zero when included in the token envelope.

tools_cost.label: Tools and integrations
tools_cost.help: Browser sessions, connectors and other metered services. Enter zero if none.

infrastructure_cost.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure_cost.help: Incremental hosting, storage and compute for this workload. Enter zero if none.

platform_cost.label: Other delivery and support cost
platform_cost.help: Modeled hosting, storage, monitoring and support cost, separate from the customer price.

customer_price.label: Proposed monthly Nest price
customer_price.help: Editable agent/brokerage pricing hypothesis. It is not validated revenue and must be tested in a paid pilot.

personal_value_per_hour.label: Optional value you assign to an hour
personal_value_per_hour.help: An optional personal comparison only. This is not salary, wages or guaranteed cash savings.

review_rate.label: Additional paid review per hour
review_rate.help: Actual extra reviewer spending, not the salary of an unchanged employee.

cash_hours.label: Hours that remove paid work
cash_hours.help: Allocate only work whose overtime, contractor or processing spend will actually stop.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly spending on that work
cash_baseline.help: The cash budget from which the reduction will come.

cash_avoided.label: Monthly spending you would stop
cash_avoided.help: One explicit amount, not hours multiplied by salary; exclude any planned-hire saving entered separately.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours agents can use for real conversations
higher_value_hours.help: Only capacity with observed demand receives an economic value.

contribution_rate.label: Incremental contribution per agent hour
contribution_rate.help: Contribution from additional work, excluding property value, commissions and costs already counted.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Expected avoided errors per month
incidents.help: Use your baseline and expected reduction. Exclude incidents also counted as risk reduction.

incident_cost.label: Incremental cost per error
incident_cost.help: Exclude labor, refunds or other losses already included elsewhere.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

opportunity: Time for agent conversations and client needs

outcomes.label: Keep agents on conversations
outcomes.help: Enter only capacity that can be redirected to real agent or brokerage work; do not treat property value or commission as Nest revenue.

tabs.label: Introduction funnel
tabs.intro: Model leads entering the agent or brokerage desk, qualification, and human review.

tabs.label: AI operating cost
tabs.intro: Keep model, token, tool, infrastructure, platform and reviewer costs separate from the proposed customer price.

tabs.label: Capacity and evidence
tabs.intro: Returned capacity is not revenue. Financial results remain insufficient until a payer, price and delivery evidence are recorded.

pricing.label: Proposed Nest monthly price
pricing.help: A €750/month working hypothesis for a qualified-introduction pilot. Treat as unvalidated until an agent or brokerage pays.

cta.privacyNote: Your data stays private. Hours are capacity. Financial amounts are modeled estimates, not observed results.

hero.eyebrow: Единственият дом или единственият купувач - не свитък от обяви.
hero.body: Кажете на Nest какво всъщност търсите или какво всъщност продавате. Nest предлага едно съвпадение. И двете страни казват „да“, преди нещо да бъде споделено.
hero.privacyLine: един мач наведнъж. Преглед на човека. Частен, докато и двете страни не се включат.
hero.characterAlt: Гнездо, което държи тетрадка и ключове с компактни крила

chat.assistantMessage: Кажете ми за дома, за който си струва да се преместя. Ще попитам само за подробностите, от които човек се нуждае рецензент, след което ще върна един смятан за подходящ.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Кажете на Nest какво ви трябва от дома...

briefDemo.introBody: Споделете само това, от което се нуждае човек рецензент. Точни адреси и данни за контакт никога не се изискват тук.
briefDemo.reviewBody: Нищо не се запазва, търси, предлага или споделя, докато сте анонимен.
briefDemo.loginNotice: Влезте, за да преместите този частен дом във вашето работно пространство на Nest за удостоверен човешки преглед.
briefDemo.expiryCopy: Неизпратените слипове изтичат след един час.
briefDemo.privacyCopy: Няма търсене на участници, споделяне на точен адрес или разкриване на контакт, докато е анонимно.
briefDemo.errorCopy: Nest не можа да запази това резюме. Моля, опитайте отново или влезте.

audience.heading: За хора, готови за истинска следваща стъпка.
audience.body: Няма публичен каталог. Няма емисия за собственост. Няма филтърна мрежа. Nest слуша, предлага едно прилягане и чака две частни „да“.
forItems: Купувачи, които сериозно търсят и могат да действат бързо.
Продавачи, които предпочитат малък брой квалифицирани, предварително съвпадащи купувачи пред открита обществена експозиция.
notForItems: Случайни посетители, които искат само да видят какво има на пазара.
Всеки, който очаква обществена собственост или мрежа от филтри.
Хора, които търсят насипен поток на сделки.

privacy.heading: Вашият адрес остава частен, докато и двамата не кажете „да“.
privacy.body: Гнездото започва с район с размер на квартал. Самоличността, данните за контакт и точният адрес остават заключени през етапите на предложението и взаимното съгласие.

stages.label: предложено
stages.title: Обща площ
stages.body: Не се вижда самоличност или точно местоположение. Всяка страна може да приеме или да премине.

stages.label: И двете приеха
stages.title: взаимно да
stages.body: И двете страни приеха. Човек завършва окончателната проверка, преди да излязат подробностите.

stages.label: Заклет
stages.title: Въведение Потвърдено
stages.body: Пълните данни за контакт, точния адрес и предложеното време вече са достъпни и за двамата участници.

privacy.proposalNote: Не се вижда самоличност или точно местоположение. Всяка страна може да приеме или да премине.

process.heading: Една внимателна последователност.
process.licensedAgentNote: Лицензиран локален агент се включва, когато сте готови да продължите напред.

proposals.heading: Две страни. един смятан за годен.
proposals.body: Тези примерни карти показват формата на предложение за гнездо. Те никога не излагат самоличност или точен адрес преди взаимното съгласие.

cards.heading: Тих дом, зелена перспектива, гъвкаво предаване.
Финансирането е подготвено, времето е подравнено, приоритетите са разбрани.

facts.label: Резюме на купувача
facts.value: Готов да се движи замислено напред

meet.heading: Уведомителят за детайли във вашия ъгъл.
meet.body: Nest слуша отвъд очевидното кратко описание: сутрешната светлина, която сте обичали, времето, което не можете да преместите, единственият компромис, който всъщност не е компромис. След това Nest връща един смятан за годен.
meet.characterAlt: Запознайте се с Nest, като държите тетрадка и ключове с компактни крила, повдигнати зад горните рамене

principles.title: слуша първо
principles.body: Разговор, а не стена от полета.

principles.title: предлага едно прилягане
principles.body: Без емисия за обществена собственост или безкрайна мрежа.

principles.title: чака две да
principles.body: Самоличността и точният адрес остават частни до взаимното съгласие.

footer.disclaimer: Nest не е лицензирана брокерска компания и не представлява нито една от страните, не договаря, оценява дома ви или не обработва вашата транзакция. Когато сте готови да продължите напред, ние ви свързваме с лицензиран локален агент, за да завършим процеса. Not a broker. Does not represent either party. Does not provide valuations. Does not negotiate.
footer.eventDisclaimer: Подробностите за панаира на втория дом са моделирани за тази инстанция на гнездо и трябва да бъдат проверени преди присъствието.

roiCalculator.heading: ROI Calculator
roiCalculator.subheading: Model a licensed second-home agent or brokerage using Nest for qualified, human-reviewed introductions in one local market.
roiCalculator.disclaimer: A modeled operating scenario with zero validated paid demand. Nest qualifies and coordinates consented introductions; it does not represent parties, value property, negotiate, earn commissions or guarantee a transaction.

currencyCopy.loading: Checking the local currency. Amounts remain in {currency} until a rate is available.
currencyCopy.unavailable: A current local exchange rate is unavailable. Amounts remain in {currency}.
currencyCopy.converted: Amounts converted from {base} to {currency} using the reference rate dated {date}.
currencyCopy.basis: Currency conversion is not local cost research. Enter your own local costs and contribution assumptions. Language changes do not change amounts.

costCopy.breakdown: How the all-in AI cost is built
costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic savings. Only the portions you assign to actual spending reductions or additional contribution receive a monetary value.

copy.workloadIntro: Model second-home leads, qualification and human review—not property sales, commissions or guaranteed matches.
copy.costIntro: Token, model, tool, infrastructure, platform and reviewer costs are delivery assumptions. Nest price is a separate unvalidated hypothesis.
copy.valueIntro: Capacity is not revenue. Enter observed contribution only after a real agent or brokerage uses and pays for the service.
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from volume × tokens per output. Extra media, tools and infrastructure stay at zero unless they apply. Additional paid review is calculated from review hours and its rate.
copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Operating burden removed (negative productivity) returns capacity. Higher-value work (potential positive productivity) creates economic value only if that capacity is used. Hours alone are not cash savings. Token cost uses a modeled input/output mix, not a provider quote.
copy.formulaLabel: Qualified briefs = leads × qualification rate. Delivery cost includes modeled token, model, tool, infrastructure, platform and human-review cost. Customer ROI remains unavailable until benefit and price are supported by evidence.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: These benefits are distinct; I have excluded costs and losses already counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my outcomes; unselected outcomes have no financial value in this estimate.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: Complete the selected assumptions to calculate financial value.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Review takes more time than the work reduced. No positive capacity is available at these assumptions.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the benefits do not overlap before including them in the financial result.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.

volume.label: Leads or briefs entering the desk each month
volume.help: Count inbound second-home enquiries in the selected market, not property transactions.

accepted_rate.label: Share becoming qualified briefs
accepted_rate.help: A modeled qualification rate. Replace it with observed funnel data after a pilot.

attendance_rate.label: Expected attendance rate
attendance_rate.help: Modeled share of accepted meetings expected to happen. Replace this with verified event records after a pilot.

minutes.label: Minutes to qualify one buyer brief today
minutes.help: Active intake and qualification time, excluding elapsed days and property-search time.

automation.label: Share of that work reduced
automation.help: An illustrative assumption to validate in a pilot, not a performance promise.

review.label: Minutes a reviewer spends confirming each brief
review.help: Human review still required before either side sees a proposal.

cycles_per_unit.label: Cycles per unit each month
cycles_per_unit.help: How many recurring order, review or processing cycles each unit runs in a typical month.

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens per qualified buyer brief
tokens_per_output.help: Modeled input and output tokens for one reviewable brief; provider usage must replace this hypothesis.

budget.label: Estimated monthly operating budget
budget.help: Include token usage, models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review.

model_cost.label: Additional model or media cost
model_cost.help: Enter separately billed models or media. Leave zero when included in the token envelope.

tools_cost.label: Tools and integrations
tools_cost.help: Browser sessions, connectors and other metered services. Enter zero if none.

infrastructure_cost.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure_cost.help: Incremental hosting, storage and compute for this workload. Enter zero if none.

platform_cost.label: Other delivery and support cost
platform_cost.help: Modeled hosting, storage, monitoring and support cost, separate from the customer price.

customer_price.label: Proposed monthly Nest price
customer_price.help: Editable agent/brokerage pricing hypothesis. It is not validated revenue and must be tested in a paid pilot.

personal_value_per_hour.label: Optional value you assign to an hour
personal_value_per_hour.help: An optional personal comparison only. This is not salary, wages or guaranteed cash savings.

review_rate.label: Additional paid review per hour
review_rate.help: Actual extra reviewer spending, not the salary of an unchanged employee.

cash_hours.label: Hours that remove paid work
cash_hours.help: Allocate only work whose overtime, contractor or processing spend will actually stop.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly spending on that work
cash_baseline.help: The cash budget from which the reduction will come.

cash_avoided.label: Monthly spending you would stop
cash_avoided.help: One explicit amount, not hours multiplied by salary; exclude any planned-hire saving entered separately.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours agents can use for real conversations
higher_value_hours.help: Only capacity with observed demand receives an economic value.

contribution_rate.label: Incremental contribution per agent hour
contribution_rate.help: Contribution from additional work, excluding property value, commissions and costs already counted.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Expected avoided errors per month
incidents.help: Use your baseline and expected reduction. Exclude incidents also counted as risk reduction.

incident_cost.label: Incremental cost per error
incident_cost.help: Exclude labor, refunds or other losses already included elsewhere.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

opportunity: Time for agent conversations and client needs

outcomes.label: Keep agents on conversations
outcomes.help: Enter only capacity that can be redirected to real agent or brokerage work; do not treat property value or commission as Nest revenue.

tabs.label: Introduction funnel
tabs.intro: Model leads entering the agent or brokerage desk, qualification, and human review.

tabs.label: AI operating cost
tabs.intro: Keep model, token, tool, infrastructure, platform and reviewer costs separate from the proposed customer price.

tabs.label: Capacity and evidence
tabs.intro: Returned capacity is not revenue. Financial results remain insufficient until a payer, price and delivery evidence are recorded.

pricing.label: Proposed Nest monthly price
pricing.help: A €750/month working hypothesis for a qualified-introduction pilot. Treat as unvalidated until an agent or brokerage pays.

cta.privacyNote: Your data stays private. Hours are capacity. Financial amounts are modeled estimates, not observed results.
